title: Tuner
summary: Tuner, um contrato para todos os canais: WhatsApp oficial com número próprio e templates, central de voz com fila e transferência, e eventos assinados para qualquer produto que se conecte.
Tuner, one contract for every channel: official WhatsApp with its own number and templates, a voice centre with queues and transfers, and signed events for any product that connects.

Products and teams that serve people by message and voice.
